title: Channels
description:
An infamous part of AE2 is its channel system. You can only connect so much with a simple cable before you run out of channels.

Controllers §oprovide§r channels: 32 from every side of the block. Controllerless networks are limited to 8 channels per network.
Cables §otransfer§r channels: standard cables have a throughput of 8 channels, while dense ones support all 32.
Buses, pattern providers and other network parts §orequire§r one channel each to run. To have this channel, a line of cables must transfer it all the way from a controller face.

The command /ae2 channelmode can change channel settings to multiply the amount of channels cables fit (x2, x3, x4) or turn the system off completely (/ae2 channelmode infinite)
